card.name: Linking words in early 1900s political history
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, was, commas, to) in history passages about early twentieth-century political movements, such as Zionism, anarchists, Chinese reformers and coups.

modes.label: Of/and after movement terms
modes.description: Links such as of or and right after ideology or group names in revolutionary history.

modes.label: Was after event subject
modes.description: The verb was after a subject like a coup or insurrection.
modes.example: The coup<< was>> ended after a brief gunfight with Munich
